text:
Avery: radical idea  tiny 'cozy polka photo booth' pop-up in the kitchen next Friday at lunch. dress code: any pattern that makes you grin. props encouraged (scarves, tiny hats, festive socks). quick 25-min run. :camera_flash::sparkles:

Bea: love it. will someone bring a phone tripod? i have zero steady hands. :raised_hands:

Jon: i'm in. bringing a ridiculous sequin beret. also proposing a 'cheesiest holiday pose' category.

Priya: YES to cheesy poses. can we also do a micro-greeting wall where people stick a 1-sentence holiday wish? anonymous allowed.

Theo: quick logistics question: will we have a printed backdrop or just the fridge magnets?

Avery: thinking printed backdrop (i can print a small one) + a string of origami stars. signup format (copy/paste):
```
Name  photo slot (in-person/dropoff OR virtual cameo)  prop (optional)
```

FestBot: Event created: "Cozy Polka Photo Booth" Fri 12:30 PT. Reply 'join' to RSVP.

Bea: Bea  in-person/dropoff  tripod + mistletoe headband

Jon: Jon  in-person/dropoff  sequin beret

Priya: Priya  virtual cameo  holiday mug (will do a 10s peek)

Theo: Theo  in-person/dropoff  origami star props

Avery: tiny rules: 1) keep it PG and brand-safe 2) don't block the kitchen for more than 2 mins 3) label props if you need them back.

Jon: prize idea: best cheesy pose gets the 'Golden Tinsel' paper crown (handmade).

Bea: poll: backdrop vibe? react :strawberry: for cozy plaid, :sparkles: for fairy lights, :pineapple: for retro polka.

Avery: :strawberry:

Jon: :pineapple:

Priya: :sparkles:

Theo: :sparkles:

Avery: tally: fairy lights leads 2-1 over plaid and polka. will print a fairy-light pattern backdrop.

FestBot: Reminder scheduled: "Cozy Polka Photo Booth" Fri 12:20 PT. Add to calendar? Reply 'yes'.

Priya: remote folks  we'll have two virtual cameo slots (30s each). DM me if you want one and i'll queue you in.

Bea: can someone bring a small lint roller? sequins = lint chaos.

Jon: i can bring one. also bringing a tiny spare mirror for last-minute hair checks.

Avery: last ask: if you want your photo shared in the #all-hands holiday thread, say 'share' after your photo. otherwise we'll keep photos in the event album.

Theo: Theo  in-person/dropoff  origami star props (i can help set up)

Bea: Bea  in-person/dropoff  tripod + mistletoe headband

Jon: Jon  in-person/dropoff  sequin beret  share

Priya: Priya  virtual cameo  holiday mug  share

Avery: perfect. i'll bring fairy lights, backdrop, glue dots, and a tiny box of sequin-safety pins. see you for tiny patterns and maximal cheese. :camera_flash::tada:
